name: Ring of the Hampered Traveler
body:
Aura faint transmutation, faint divination, faint abjuration; CL 1st; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring looks like a traveler’s ring. When the wearer uses the longstrider ability, he becomes exhausted at the end of the effect’s duration.

Additionally, the know direction ability has a 20% chance of yielding a random direction instead of “north”.

Finally, when the endure elements ability is utilized, the wearer instead becomes vulnerable to elemental attacks, taking 50% more damage from fire, cold, electrical and acid-based attacks. This vulnerability lasts for 24 hours.

This ring can only be removed by the casting of remove curse upon it, which renders the ring non-magical.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items traveler’s ring

Identification DC 26
False Identification DC 16
